purpose: Parse the signed proposal accept_token from the incoming acceptance request and expose its components for verification.

node.name: Security - Parse HMAC Accept Token
node.notes: Phase 3.0.1.3. Accepts the token from either $json.accept_token or $json.query.accept_token. This node only parses structure; it does not trust the token until 3.0.1.4 verifies signature and expiry.

implementation_notes: Do not treat token_valid_structure=true as authorization.
The parsed lead ID must not be used to fetch/accept the proposal until signature and expiry verification succeeds.
Keep the original request fields intact for downstream audit logging.
test_cases: Valid token with lead_id.expiry.signature parses into three fields.
Token with wrong number of segments returns INVALID_ACCEPT_TOKEN_FORMAT.
A structurally valid but forged signature remains untrusted until 3.0.1.4.
